description: This Dart file implements the TaskRepository class, which provides CRUD operations for Task objects stored in an SQLite database via a helper class. It includes methods to fetch, insert, update, and delete tasks, handling database queries and mappings.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository that abstracts CRUD operations for Task objects using SQLite.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all tasks ordered by creation time, with incomplete tasks first.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the database and returns the task with its new id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its id from the database.
